bigOGrowth.title: How Big O grows
bigOGrowth.constant: O(1): the line stays flat. The work doesn't grow with n.
bigOGrowth.log: O(log n): grows very slowly. Doubling n adds only one more step.
bigOGrowth.linear: O(n): a straight line. Twice the input means twice the work.
bigOGrowth.quadratic: O(n²): shoots up. At n = 1,000 it's already 1,000,000 operations.
bigOGrowth.summary: From best to worst: O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n²).

arrayReindex.title: Array operations and re-indexing
arrayReindex.start: Every item in an array has an index, starting at 0.
arrayReindex.push: push(17) adds to the end. No other item moves: O(1).
arrayReindex.pop: pop() removes from the end. No other item moves: O(1).
arrayReindex.shift: shift() removes the first item, so every other item moves down one index: O(n).
arrayReindex.unshift: unshift(11) adds to the start, so every item moves up one index: O(n).

binarySearch.title: Binary search: cut it in half
binarySearch.start: Find {{target}} in a sorted array of {{count}} items.
binarySearch.goRight: The middle is {{middle}}, smaller than {{target}}: throw away the left half.
binarySearch.goLeft: The middle is {{middle}}, bigger than {{target}}: throw away the right half.
binarySearch.found: Found {{target}} after {{checks}} checks. log₂(8) = 3: that's O(log n).
